ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, the center of the circle is labeled D, and rectangle ABCD is located to the upper right of the circle center D; A is directly above D, C is directly to the right of D, and B is the upper-right corner of the rectangle and lies on the circle. The shaded part is located within the upper-right quarter of the circle, and is the region remaining after removing rectangle ABCD from this quarter circle. According to the problem, AD=4, CD=3. Because ABCD is a rectangle, DB is the hypotenuse of the right triangle with AD and CD as the legs. Also because B is on the circle and D is the center of the circle, DB is the radius of the circle. Using the Pythagorean theorem: DB=√(4^2+3^2)=√25=5. Shaded area = area of a quarter circle − area of the rectangle: (1/4)π(5^2) − 3×4 = 25π/4 − 12. Approximate calculation: 25π/4≈19.63, so the shaded area≈19.63−12=7.63. 7.63 is between 7 and 8.

raw_record.question_text: $\text{ABCD}$ is a rectangle, $\text{D}$ is the center of the circle, and $\text{B}$ is on the circle. If $\text{AD}=4$ and $\text{CD}=3$, between which two consecutive integers does the area of the shaded region lie?

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a circle centered at D with rectangle ABCD in the upper-right quadrant; the shaded region is exactly the part of the quarter-disk between the vertical and horizontal radii through D that lies outside the rectangle. From the text, AD=4 and CD=3, and since B is the opposite corner of the rectangle and lies on the circle, DB is the circle radius. Use the Pythagorean theorem on right triangle DCB or DAB: DB=sqrt(3^2+4^2)=5. Then compute shaded area as quarter-circle area minus rectangle area: (1/4)π(5^2)−(3)(4)=25π/4−12≈7.6, so it lies between 7 and 8.

图像中，圆的中心标为 D，矩形 ABCD 位于圆心 D 的右上方；A 在 D 的正上方，C 在 D 的正右方，B 是矩形的右上角并落在圆上。阴影部分位于圆的右上四分之一内，并且是在该四分之一圆中去掉矩形 ABCD 后剩下的区域。

根据题意，AD=4，CD=3。因为 ABCD 是矩形，所以 DB 是以 AD 和 CD 为直角边的直角三角形的斜边。又因为 B 在圆上且 D 是圆心，所以 DB 是圆的半径。

用勾股定理：DB=√(4^2+3^2)=√25=5。

阴影面积 = 四分之一圆面积 − 矩形面积：
(1/4)π(5^2) − 3×4 = 25π/4 − 12。

近似计算：25π/4≈19.63，所以阴影面积≈19.63−12=7.63。7.63 介于 7 和 8 之间。

From the text, AD=4 and CD=3, so the rectangle diagonal DB is the radius because B is on the circle; hence DB=5. Conceptually draw DB. The two shaded pieces together equal the sum of two sectors centered at D, one between the vertical radius and DB and one between DB and the horizontal radius, minus the two right triangles DAB and DCB. The two sector angles add to 90° because AD is perpendicular to CD in the rectangle, so their total sector area is a quarter of the radius-5 circle. Image description: The diagram shows a circle centered at D. A rectangle ABCD sits in the upper-right part of the circle, with D at the lower-left corner of the rectangle, A above D, C to the right of D, and B the upper-right corner. The shaded region is inside the circle but outside the rectangle, consisting of two pieces: one above side AB near the top arc, and one to the right of side BC near the right arc.

Reasoning: Since ABCD is a rectangle, AD = BC = 4 and CD = AB = 3. Point B is on the circle and D is the center, so DB is the radius. The diagonal DB has length sqrt(4^2 + 3^2) = sqrt(25) = 5. If we draw diagonal DB, the shaded region can be seen as two circular sectors centered at D minus the two right triangles DAB and DCB. The sector angles together make 90 degrees because AD is perpendicular to CD, so the total sector area is one quarter of the circle: (1/4)π(5^2) = 25π/4. The two triangles together have the same area as the rectangle, which is 4 × 3 = 12. Therefore the shaded area is 25π/4 − 12 ≈ 19.635 − 12 = 7.635. This lies between 7 and 8.
